text: Nice, could you make it a bit easier to scale up when it comes, i realize that dragging this gizmo for 48 steps is ass because it goes out of the camera FoV like 4x over, i just need a value-passable option to tack onto the scaling ability, put it in the context menu since its not that common of a use
resolution: Added a nested Gizmo → Scale By… action with exact numeric entry (including ×48), presets, validation, atomic uniform scaling around the current selection pivot, automatic camera reframe unless locked, and one host journal entry. Added Zig/TypeScript coverage, a ReleaseFast editor build, and a headless ×48 → one Undo → exact restore smoke test.
